name: tunio
description: Run your Tunio radio stations from ChatGPT: schedules, playlists, jingles, announcements, playback and reports on what aired.

interface.longDescription:
Tunio is a platform for running radio stations for businesses and creators: background music for venues, branded in-store radio and online stations. The Tunio plugin lets ChatGPT manage your stations through your own Tunio account.

Ask in plain words and ChatGPT works with your account:
- See your stations, what is playing now and what aired recently.
- Build and change the content and music schedules: time slots, schedule profiles, instant playlists and music overrides.
- Create and edit playlists, and organise jingles into bundles.
- Create voiced announcements and jingles, and schedule them on air.
- Get an air report for any period: plays by kind, top tracks and jingles, repeats, genres and gaps in the broadcast.

You sign in with your Tunio account and approve access on the Tunio consent screen. ChatGPT acts as you and sees only your account. Tools that change data are marked as such, so ChatGPT asks before it runs them.

Tunio is operated by Orange Solutions LLC (Yerevan, Armenia); see https://tunio.ai/en/terms-of-service.
defaultPrompt: What is playing on my Tunio stations right now?
Show the air report for my station for the last day.
Create a Friday evening playlist with lounge and house.

positive.prompt: List my Tunio stations and tell me which are online.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the test account's station "Review Café Radio" with its status (online), timezone and stream URL. No other accounts' stations appear.

positive.prompt: How did Review Café Radio sound over the last 24 hours? How many jingles and announcements aired?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the station, calls the air report for the last 24 hours and summarises plays by kind (music, jingles, announcements), top tracks and any gaps, using only numbers returned by the tool.

positive.prompt: What playlists do I have and which genres does each one use?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's playlists (for example Morning Café: jazz, acoustic; Evening Lounge: lounge, house; Weekend Upbeat: pop, dance) with their genres.

positive.prompt: Create a playlist called Review Test with lounge and jazz genres.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks the available genres, asks the user to confirm the write action, then creates the playlist and returns its title and id. The playlist then appears in get_playlists.

positive.prompt: Show my announcements and give me a link to listen to the welcome announcement.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's announcements (including "Welcome announcement") with their text and state, and returns the public audio_url of the welcome announcement on cdn2.tunio.ai.

negative.prompt: Upgrade my Tunio plan and charge my card.
Show me the schedule of a Tunio station that belongs to another customer.
What is the weather in Paris tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: stations, schedules, playlists, jingles, announcements, playback control and air reports.
